feed.title: Stickman MCP Releases
feed.subtitle: Deterministic 2D stick-figure animation and multi-scene movie engine with a local stdio MCP server.

entry.title: Stickman MCP v0.3.1 — Discovery Assets, README & Live Website Polish
entry.summary: Ships machine-readable discovery endpoints (llms.txt, llms-full.txt, sitemap.xml, Atom feed.xml, robots.txt, 1200x630 og-card.png, Schema.org JSON-LD), MCP Registry server.json, CITATION.cff, scriptless 1200x420 README hero banner, and live website polish with theme toggle, high-contrast studio controls, and hero stage preview.

entry.title: Stickman MCP v0.3.0 — Multi-Scene Movies, Virtual Camera, 6-Axis Critique & Transparent WebM
entry.summary: Adds stickman.movie/v1 multi-scene composition with contextual backdrops and fade/wipe transitions, auto-director virtual camera, 2.5D depth planes, spotlight focus, editorial callouts, curved Bezier spines, gaze cues, hand glyphs, shared multi-actor prop handoffs, 6-axis stickman_critique, ui://stickman/player MCP App, parallel MP4 rasterization, and transparent VP9 WebM export.

entry.title: Stickman MCP v0.2.2 — Full-Stage Hatched CAD Blueprints & Scroll-Scrubbed Playhead
entry.summary: Adds full-stage architectural CAD blueprint rendering (--blueprint / --style blueprint), interactive scroll-scrubbed <stickman-player> timelines via bindScrollTimeline, and DESIGN.md token/contrast/anti-slop linting.

entry.title: Stickman MCP v0.2.1 — Multi-Actor v2 Stabilization & Release Parity
entry.summary: Hardens stickman.animation/v2 multi-actor choreography, storyboard spatial/seam diagnostics, and offline release-candidate verification.

entry.title: Stickman MCP v0.2.0 — stickman.animation/v2 Choreography, Props & Storyboard Review
entry.summary: Introduces stickman.animation/v2 multi-actor choreography with semantic anchors, cue synchronization, geometric vector props/add-ons, storyboard contact sheets, and expanded runtime motion catalog.

entry.title: Stickman MCP v0.1.0 — Deterministic 2D Stick-Figure Engine & Local Stdio MCP Server
entry.summary: Initial release of the deterministic 2D vector stick-figure compiler, CLI, local stdio MCP server, safe export root boundary, continuous film composer, and offline motion gallery.
